about.title: About
about.content: I'm Fatima Zahra , a full-stack development student from Morocco with a love for clean design, smooth interactions, and beautiful digital experiences. I build responsive websites, intuitive interfaces, and polished web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies. I enjoy creating elegant UIs, bringing ideas to life, and turning concepts into functional, user-friendly products. I am constantly learning, improving my skills, and exploring new tools in web development and AI. Soft aesthetics, attention to detail, and thoughtful user experience define my work.

items.position: Software Development Intern, Tanger Med Port Authority (TMPA) - Tangier, Morocco
items.description: Developed a reusable real-time support chat module for integration into TMPA applications. Built role-based client, agent, and admin workflows with JWT authentication and conversation management. Implemented real-time messaging using Socket.IO and developed REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, working with React, MongoDB, Mongoose, Docker, and Docker Compose.

Developed multiple web applications, including a weather application, user management system, task manager, and e-commerce platform. Built responsive interfaces and full-stack features using modern JavaScript technologies, working with APIs, authentication, databases, CRUD operations, and Git-based workflows.

items.position: Web Developer, Euroweb Digital - Tangier, Morocco
items.description: Developed and customized responsive websites and e-commerce solutions using WordPress and Divi. Implemented client requirements and improved user experience across desktop and mobile devices.
Pursuing a degree in Software Development with an emphasis on full stack technologies. Learning through real-world projects and gaining strong skills in frontend, backend, and project management.

items.institution: Abdelmalek Essaadi University, Tangier - B.A. in Human Resources Management
items.description: Building expertise in organizational behavior, talent management, and leadership strategy. This program enriches my technical background with essential human-centric and collaboration skills.
Earned with honors, specializing in Life and Earth Sciences.
